classDefinitions.positiveDefinition: A complete powered Rhino machine sold as base equipment.
classDefinitions.exclusions: Parts, ordinary-use consumables, and optional equipment.

classDefinitions.positiveDefinition: A component primarily restoring, repairing, or replacing a constituent component.
classDefinitions.exclusions: Items primarily augmenting use and ordinary-use worn/depleted supplies.
ambiguousBoundaryCases: Knobs or guards belonging to optional assemblies

classDefinitions.positiveDefinition: An item expected to be worn, depleted, dressed, or repeatedly replaced through ordinary operation.
classDefinitions.exclusions: Durable machine components and optional equipment.

classDefinitions.positiveDefinition: An item primarily augmenting or extending use, not ordinarily required to restore the base machine.
ambiguousBoundaryCases: Clamps, tables, and guides that may be standard

fieldRoles.shopifyCategory: Official taxonomy classification; distinct from Rhino product class and its separately preserved business meaning.

fieldRoles.vendor: Native Vendor means marketed product brand, not store seller and not necessarily manufacturer.
